fake_mcp_stdio.py.description: Provide a standard-library MCP stdio server with tools and failure modes for client tests.

test_aos_lib_missing.py.description: lib/aos 的工具抄到找不到 lib 的地方時，一律印一行 ModuleMissing、退 1（cl-9 對齊成標準樣板，不再是 traceback）。

test_directive_value.py.description: 驗 directive_value：給了 file＝{"$ref": "#/…"} 取那份檔自己；沒給＝原封不動（11-12 ref-hash R1）；resolve_path 一律給設定檔。

test_file_tools_paths.py.description: 檔案工具拿掉工作區限制（11-10 tool-packs，使用者「3.對」）：相對從 $AOS_WS、絕對照用，工作區外也能讀寫改搬。

test_hook_run.py.description: Verify the shared hook engine: entry validation, running handlers through aos-exec, replies, blocking, on_error, timeouts, ordering and conditions.

test_index_extra_keys.py.description: index_view 對 index 一項裡多出來的鍵（timeout_ms、自訂鍵…）照常印「名<TAB>description」、不報錯：index 的格都只是參考（使用者 11-12 晚）。

test_index_link.py.description: index paths and $ref share one "string -> place" rule after #: ".." steps out one level, stepping out of the root object

test_index_view.py.description: index_view（lib/aos_index.py，thinking 2026-11/12/index-tools）的定向測試：實跑 _entry，驗三種給法（只 path、只 index、兩個疊著）、key、分頁、沒有 index、壞掉的 index。

test_json_tools.py.description: json 工具一族（lib/aos_json.py；簡單組 json_*、複雜組 jsonx_*，thinking 2026-11/12/json-tools）的定向測試：每支實跑 _entry，驗輸出與檔案內容。

test_mcp_client.py.description: Verify MCP stdio and HTTP sessions, authentication, wire failures, deadlines, and cleanup.

test_mcp_freeze.py.description: Test lib/mcp_freeze.py: registry names, $ref expansion and $-key removal, description truncation, _metainfo hints, and diff lines.

test_metainfo.py.description: Verify optional metadata reading, timeout declarations, and safe cost formulas; bad metadata is skipped with a note.

test_observed.py.description: Verify shared observation initialization, strict failures and measured call cells.

test_observed_children.py.description: Verify observed_children: a child's declared accounts are copied (and only those), take_child hands the mark over once.

test_tool_io_keys.py.description: 不認得的 stdin 鍵＝ArgumentsBad（使用者 11-10 晚「那就報錯」）；additionalProperties 與自由物件照舊收。

test_tool_io_metainfo.py.description: tool_io.load_tooldef 也讀 _metainfo.json 的 tooldef（11-12 metainfo，N-69）：先裡面、再 _tooldef.json，頂層鍵淺合併、外面贏。

test_tool_io_place.py.description: Test tool_io.place and tool_io.os_reason: error lines name program-made paths relative to $AOS_STACK / $AOS_DAEMON / $AOS_WS (counted from the caller…

test_tool_spec.py.description: Test lib/tool_spec.py: declaration to _tooldef/_metainfo, SpecBad, write_defs into a folder and a JSON pointer, and main() at run time.
